rentals.heading: Rentals
rentals.detail: Tick what you rent and price it. Unticked gear leaves the kit form, and fits that already ask for it stay on the prep list, marked.

It checks SSI, NAUI, SDI, GUE and CMAS, and PADI once “PADI checks (beta)” in Features is on, in Chrome or Edge on a computer.

bundle.heading: What’s in the bundle
bundle.fileCount: {count, plural, one {# file, with a row count for each} other {# files, with a row count for each}}
bundle.description: One ZIP with a README and a CSV per record type. Every date carries its timezone, money is in cents, and deleted records come along too.

notIncluded.label: Not included, on purpose:
notIncluded.text: offline manifest copies, notification retry queues, Stripe account linkage, the buddy-team trail, weather-cancellation state, DiveDay’s own reconciliation ledgers, and unstored pasted image URLs. Staff notes, the activity trail, notification outcomes, checkout attempts, promo redemptions and course interests <mono>do</mono> export. Photos and safely stored imported receipts export as real files in <mono>photos/</mono>. Credentials, calendar links, and your WhatsApp account never export. See the README.

crewSheet.heading: Crew sheet
crewSheet.description: Departures worked, hours, and each crew member’s share of the month’s tips, as one CSV.
crewSheet.note: It records the month as it happened; what anyone is owed is your bookkeeper’s call.

import.comingFrom: Coming from <eve>EVE</eve>, <diveshop360>DiveShop360</diveshop360>, or <spreadsheet>a spreadsheet</spreadsheet>? See the matching guide, then come back here to bring it in.

notice.notAuthorized: Importing writes divers’ personal and medical records, so it’s limited to owners and managers.

contact.detail: A row with an email matches an existing diver on re-import; without one, it’s always a new record.

emergencyContact.detail: Name and phone, when your file has them.

diveInsurance.detail: Free text, exactly as your file holds it. It never gates anyone.

rentalSizes.detail: BCD, wetsuit, boot, and fin sizes become a rental-fit profile.

certificationCard.detail: Marked imported, and clears the level gate. If your file says the card was never verified, it waits for staff instead. Unrecognized levels need manual entry.

specialtyCards.detail: Marked imported. Each one’s gate stays shut until staff give it a one-tap confirm, whatever your file says.

nitrox.detail: Marked imported. Until staff give it a one-tap confirm, that diver gets plain air. Boarding waits on it only where your file says the card was never verified.

signedWaivers.detail: A row marked already-accepted is trusted, medical clearance included, and marked imported. Individual medical answers are never reconstructed, only the outcome.

waiverDocuments.detail: Fetched once from your file’s URL and kept for audit. Images and PDFs up to 5 MB.

role.detail: Everyone imports as a diver, never a staff role or a login.

cardOnFile.detail: Stay with your payment processor. DiveDay never imports card numbers or CVCs.

pastVisits.detail: One row per booking up to today becomes visit history. It is not a dive, and it never appears on your schedule or counts toward capacity.

paymentHistory.detail: Unverified history in Orders. A clearly parsed amount in your shop currency counts in the revenue/refund aggregate; it never becomes a live Stripe order or booking payment.

serviceHistory.detail: Imported separately, through Settings → Import gear history. Units match by tag or serial number.

diverNotes.detail: Customer remarks and staff notes become private notes on the diver’s profile.

wizard.heading: Upload a contacts file
wizard.intro: A CSV from your old system, or DiveDay’s own <mono>contacts.csv</mono>. Nothing is written until you confirm the preview.

fieldLabels.boot_size: Boot size (kept as one fin & boot size)

wizard.waiverRowsNoticeOther: {count} rows claim a waiver already accepted at a prior shop. DiveDay trusts that, medical clearance included, and marks it “imported”.
wizard.visitRowsNoticeOne: {count} row records a past visit. See “What comes across” above for what that does and doesn’t mean.
wizard.visitRowsNoticeOther: {count} rows record a past visit. See “What comes across” above for what that does and doesn’t mean.
wizard.paymentHistoryRowsNoticeOne: {count} payment, refund, or receipt source row will be imported as unverified history. They never create Stripe orders or charges.
wizard.paymentHistoryRowsNoticeOther: {count} payment, refund, or receipt source rows will be imported as unverified history. They never create Stripe orders or charges.

wizard.bookingsAfterTodayOther: {count} bookings are after today. They aren’t seats here. Add them on the board, or keep them in {system} until they sail.
wizard.previewSwipeHint: Swipe the table to see every column →

wizard.hiddenRowsNoticeOther: Showing the first {limit} rows. All {total} are imported on confirm.

result.cardsLineOther: {cards} imported, flagged imported, with a one-tap confirm on each diver.

result.specialtyGateNote: A dive that requires one of those specialties waits on that confirm. Tap it on the diver’s record and the gate opens.
result.waiversLineOne: {count} waiver imported as accepted, marked “imported” on the diver’s profile.
result.waiversLineOther: {count} waivers imported as accepted, marked “imported” on the diver’s profile.
result.waiversSkippedExistingNote: {count} diver(s) already had a current waiver on file, left untouched.
result.waiversSkippedNoTemplateNoteOne: {count} skipped. Set up a waiver template first.
result.waiversSkippedNoTemplateNoteOther: {count} skipped. Set up a waiver template first.

result.visitsLineOne: {count} past visit added to divers’ shop history.
result.visitsLineOther: {count} past visits added to divers’ shop history.

result.paymentHistoryLineOther: {count} unverified payment / receipt source records added to Orders.

result.notesLineOther: {count} internal notes imported to diver profiles.

issues.emailInvalid: Email “{email}” doesn’t look valid, so the diver was imported without one.
issues.cardMarkedUnverified: Your file marks this certification “{status}”, so it was imported for staff review rather than as verified.
issues.specialtyNotGated: Specialty “{specialty}” isn’t a specialty we gate on (deep, wreck, night, drysuit), so nothing was imported for it.
issues.specialtyNoCardNumber: Specialty “{specialty}” has no certification number on the row, so it was not imported.
issues.specialtyImportedVerifiedOne: Specialty certification imported as verified from your records. A dive that requires one waits until a staffer confirms they’ve seen it.
issues.specialtyImportedVerifiedOther: {count} specialty certifications imported as verified from your records. A dive that requires one waits until a staffer confirms they’ve seen it.
issues.specialtyImportedPendingOne: Specialty certification imported for staff review.
issues.specialtyImportedPendingOther: {count} specialty certifications imported for staff review.
issues.agencyUnrecognized: Certification agency unrecognized, so it was imported as “other”.
issues.levelNamesSpecialty: Certification “{level}” names a specialty, not a level, so the specialty column was used and no level was imported. Add that certification record in DiveDay if it’s a separate one.
issues.levelIsTechnical: Certification “{level}” is a technical or overhead rating, not a recreational rung, so it was not imported. Record it by hand if your shop gates on it.
issues.levelNotGated: Certification “{level}” isn’t a level we gate on, so the certification was not imported. Add the record in DiveDay if your shop needs to keep it.
issues.levelNoCardNumber: Certification level “{level}” has no usable certification number, so the certification was not imported.
issues.certImportedVerified: Certification imported as verified from your records.
issues.nitroxImportedVerified: Nitrox certification imported as verified from your records. Fills give plain air until a staffer taps confirm.
issues.nitroxImportedPending: Nitrox certification imported for staff review. A nitrox-required departure holds this diver until it is confirmed.
issues.nitroxNoCardNumber: Nitrox marked on the source with no certification number. Add and verify the nitrox certification in DiveDay.
issues.waiverDateInvalid: Waiver accepted date “{value}” isn’t a real calendar date (expected YYYY-MM-DD), so it was imported dated to today instead.
issues.waiverImported: Waiver imported as accepted: trusted from the prior shop, medical clearance included, and marked “imported”.
issues.dobInvalid: Date of birth “{value}” isn’t a plausible calendar date (expected YYYY-MM-DD, 1900 or later, not in the future), so the diver was imported without it.
issues.visitDateUnreadable: Visit date “{value}” isn’t a date we can read, so the diver imports without this visit.
issues.visitNoReference: Visit imported without a booking reference. A re-import matches on date, name, and amount, so two identical bookings on one day come in as one visit.
issues.visitNoDate: This row names a past booking but carries no date, so the diver imports without this visit.
issues.paymentHistoryDateUnreadable: Payment history date “{value}” isn’t a date we can read, so that source record won’t import.
issues.paymentHistoryNoDate: This payment or receipt source row has no usable date, so it won’t import.
issues.noName: This row has no name and was skipped.
issues.mergedDuplicate: Same diver as row {row} ({email}), so this row’s certifications, waiver, and past visit are added to them, with contact details left as the earlier row has them.
issues.noEmailNewRecord: This row has no email and was imported as a new record; a re-import can’t match it to update.
issues.sizeTooLong: {field} “{value}” is too long for a size box, so the diver imports without it. Set it on their record, or their gear form will ask them for it.

import.declinedSizeNote: {item} from the import, too long for the size box: “{value}”

errors.notOwnerOrManager: Importing contacts is limited to the shop’s owner or manager.
errors.csvRequired: Choose a CSV file to import.
errors.noImportableRows: No rows could be imported. Every row was missing a name or duplicated.
errors.fileTooLarge: The file is too large. The limit is {limitMb} MB.
errors.tooManyColumns: Too many columns ({count}). The limit is {limit}.
errors.tooManyRows: Too many rows ({count}). The limit is {limit} per import, so split the file and import it in batches.
errors.cellTooLongHeader: A cell in the header row is longer than {limit} characters. Check for a pasted document instead of a spreadsheet.
errors.cellTooLongRow: A cell in row {row} is longer than {limit} characters. Check for a pasted document instead of a spreadsheet.
errors.noNameColumn: No name column found. The file needs a full name, or first and last name, to import people.
